thread.title: Jim Cramer Breaks Down the Fourth Industrial Revolution

author: Home
title: Jim Cramer Breaks Down the Fourth Industrial Revolution
text:
We've all heard of the industrial revolution, right?
Well, according to Jim Cramer, we're in the fourth industrial revolution.
Cloud Communications Firm Twilio CEO Jeff Lawson Talks $2B SendGrid Deal If you don't know what that means, don't panic.
IBM: Has Big Blue Become Big Red? Basically, Cramer explained, it's the emergence of cloud-based technology. It's the fourth major industrial revolution that has disrupted the world.
Companies such as Amazon's ( AMZN ) web services, Salesforce ( CRM ) , and Apple ( AAPL ) are just a couple of examples of major companies using the cloud.
All three companies are part of Jim Cramer's Action Alerts Plus portfolio .
Cramer said that he's constantly keeping an eye on various cloud companies and explained that he frequently makes trips out to California to visit Silicon Valley and see where the technology advances are heading.
Most recently, Cramer was in California to cover Dreamforce, which is Salesforce's yearly conference .
